A fairly hefty black powder bomb. An explosion from this would certainly do damage to anything nearby.
This bomb has been modified to burst into a sustained flame in a larger area when it explodes.
This customized bomb will erupt into a burst of blinding light when it explodes. Disorientating anything nearby.
This bomb has been modified to burst into a sustained gust of freezing air in a larger area when it explodes.
This customized bomb will splash life-giving liquid all around it instead of exploding. Anyone caught in the blast will be healed.

This brew will spread corrosive ooze around the location it shatters in.
Anything caught by the ooze will slowly melt if it can't wash it off in liquid.

This brew combines the properties of a liquid flame and snap freeze potion.

The area around where the vial is thrown will be snap-frozen, then set ablaze for an extended duration.
When shattered, this brew will unleash a raging inferno which spreads like a gas.
When shattered, this brew will unleash an electrical storm in an area around the location it breaks at.
This brew combines the properties of a toxic gas and paralytic gas potion. When exposed to open air the liquid of the brew will erupt into both gasses at once.

These simple shafts of spike-tipped wood are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist.

Due to their size and simple construction, darts will never break.

These wicked darts are tipped with an acidic rotberry-based compound, which will aggressively eat through anything the dart comes into contact with. The corrosion is strong enough to easily kill most standard enemies.
These darts are tipped with a starflower-based compound which grants a boost in power to their target. The dart itself is still harmful though.
These darts are tipped with a fadeleaf-based compound which will teleport their target a short distance away.
These darts are tipped with a blindweed-based compound which will blind their target for a short time. They do not disorient however, so an enemy will still know where they last saw you.
These darts are tipped with a firebloom-based compound which will burst into brilliant flames on impact.
These darts are tipped with a swiftthistle-based compound which will give their target a boost in movement speed.
These darts are tipped with a sungrass-based compound which grants a burst of healing to their target. The dart itself is still harmful though.
These darts are tipped with an icecap-based compound which will significantly chill their target.
These darts are tipped with a stormvine-based compound which will deliver a nasty shock to their target.
These darts are tipped with a sorrowmoss-based compound which will poison their target.
These darts are tipped with a dreamfoil-based compound which will cause an immense drowsiness in their target, drastically decreasing their agility.
These darts are tipped with an earthroot-based compound which will paralyze their target for a short time.
This powerful reagent will completely neutralize all harmful effects on the drinker when quaffed. It can be thrown at a target to cleanse them as well.

Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of corrosive rust-colored gas. The gas is less concentrated however, and will not last for very long.

This flask contains an unusual compound which bursts into flame shortly after mixing with saliva.
Quickly spitting the liquid will allow the user to spew flame from their mouth!
The chemical contained in this potion will evaporate into a freezing cloud upon exposure to open air.
This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon being opened.

When opened, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing yellow haze.
Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates.
When exposed to air, the liquid in this flask will produce a thick smoky fog which completely blocks vision.
Upon being released, the chemical contained in this potion will rapidly react, instantly freezing all within its effect.
Throwing this potion will create a cloud of concentrated vapor, which will instantly condense and pour down onto the environment.

Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of toxic green gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.

With a right-click, this scroll will upgrade a single weapon, improving its quality.
A single weapon can be upgraded up to three times with these scrolls.
This pot is filled with magical water. Items can be mixed in the pot to create something new!
ko: 이 솥에는 마법의 물이 가득 차 있다. 솥 안에 물건을 섞어 새로운 것을 만들어 낼 수 있다!
